properties.districtsNote: None. The Census draws no tribal district on this land, so no council seat belongs to it.
properties.recognition: Recognized by the State of Georgia under Code Section 44-12-300 of the Official Code of Georgia, as amended by House Bill 43 of 2024, and not by the federal government. The name is the one Code Section 44-12-300, as House Bill 43 amended it gives.
properties.rosterWhy: Not carried yet. This app has not read a council list for this nation and has no site of the nation's own to link, so the card names nobody.
